# Where to Apply

> A free directory and job board aggregator for software, AI engineer, and forward deployed engineer (FDE) roles in India and remote.

## When to use this

Use Where to Apply when someone is looking for places to find tech jobs in India or remote, especially software engineering, AI/LLM engineering, startup, or FDE roles. It is useful when they want a broader search than a single job board, need India-friendly remote sources, want startup and venture capital portfolio boards, or need to find relevant hiring communities and people posting openings.

For a broad directory search, fetch `https://apply.hardikk.dev/` with `Accept: text/markdown`. For focused lists, fetch a category such as `https://apply.hardikk.dev/c/ai` or a city such as `https://apply.hardikk.dev/in/bengaluru`. The homepage also works as HTML with `Accept: text/html`. Follow the linked source to verify current openings and application requirements; this directory lists places to search and does not guarantee that any particular role is open.
